question: On exact-cofactor-4 E/F_(q^3) instances with certified common m=2 plane-quartic and m=3 hyperelliptic genus-3 covers, does the full Diem-Thome line harvest have adequate PP yield, cycles, rank/nullity and post-SGE sparsity to survive evaluator e5 gates K1-K4?

claims.text: Every included curve has a verified common-branch m=2/m=3 certificate, prime ell and exact cofactor four.
The measured four-size, six-curve full harvest survives or fires K1-K4 exactly as preregistered.
claims.if_supported: advance the common-cover plane-quartic relation family to an end-to-end follow-on; no deployed-curve claim
claims.if_not_supported: record the exact failed gate as a new row or reject the family at the measured scale

hypotheses.statement: The practical Diem-Thome PP graph produces a giant component and enough usable relations at N=ceil(2.83 sqrt(q+1)).
hypotheses.mechanism: Split residual intersections create two-large-prime graph edges; cycles eliminate the large primes without class-group walks.

predictions.minimum_effect: each size mean unique PP/pair >= 0.20 and every curve usable_cycles >= N+2

data_seen.measured: historical desk q=257 PP/FP ranges only; not the prospective streams
published q approximately 2^31 matrix and heuristic graph evidence

hypotheses.statement: Cycle-selected FB rows have nullity one and a mean weight low enough for e5's K4 projection.
hypotheses.mechanism: The factor base spans the ell-part while sparse LP elimination avoids the published 352-nonzero constant at the measured scales.

predictions.minimum_effect: nullity=1 on every curve and q=32771 mean projected cost <= 0.6 matched round-4 incumbent

data_seen.measured: published DT weight correction and evaluator projection; no prospective streams

arms.description: Full two-large-prime Diem-Thome line harvest on prospectively built common-cover plane quartics.

decision_rule.text: Kill K1 if any q-size six-curve mean unique_PP/pairs is below 0.20; kill K2 if any curve has usable_cycles < N+2; kill K3 if any curve has nullity != 1; kill K4 if at q=32771, 7.3e6+0.53e6*mean(w) exceeds the frozen canonical decimal 64530357.539066718 = 32265178769533359/500000000, derived pre-data from 0.6*9.967e10*(2^15/2^22)^1.408. Advance only if all gates survive and all 24 cells and required artifacts validate.
decision_rule.threshold: K1 exact 1/5; K2 N+2; K3 nullity exactly 1; K4 exact frozen rational 32265178769533359/500000000 M_q
decision_rule.statistic: per-size exact integer comparison for K1, per-curve exact values for K2/K3, and q=32771 exact reduced-rational six-curve arithmetic mean w with integer cross-products for K4
decision_rule.interval: none: deterministic exact-count gates; report six-curve ranges descriptively
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: PP yield margin over 0.20, cycle margin over N+2, nullity difference from one, and projected-cost ratio to matched incumbent
